provider: nsf access / open storage network (as an individual route)

free_tier.stated: 10 TB to 50 TB of S3-compatible storage per project through the ACCESS allocation process, at no cost to researchers; an allocation needs an eligible ACCESS project.
free_tier.notes: ACCESS allocates resources at no cost to researchers, OSN storage included; the OSN documentation gives a rate of 3,000 ACCESS credits per 1 TB.

retention.stated: Bucket storage is never purged and not backed up.

interface_detail: S3-compatible buckets with an endpoint URL, a bucket name and up to two key pairs; no shell or mounted filesystem.
tooling: AWS CLI, Cyberduck, Rclone and Restic against the bucket endpoint; buckets and keys are created in the OSN portal.

limits.value: 50 TB per-project quota, shared across all buckets in the project

identity_cost.detail: A PI must be a researcher or educator based in the U.S. and affiliated with an eligible organisation; persons based outside the U.S. cannot request or lead an allocation, and users must be affiliated with an eligible organisation.

reliability_note: Eligibility changed under NSF Important Notice No. 149 (July 10, 2025): an organisational affiliation is required and persons based outside the U.S. cannot lead an allocation.
confidence_note: documented: the project allocation range, the S3-compatible bucket storage and the per-project quota were read on 2026-11-03 at https://support.access-ci.org/documentation/resources/osn, and the organisational-affiliation and U.S.-based PI requirements at https://allocations.access-ci.org/allocations-policy.
